about_the_game:
About This Game

Grabby Lust Ghost is a chaotic Rouge-Like Deckbuilding horror game with a cozy yet eerie atmosphere.
Mix ingredients, create chaotic synergies, and navigate a haunted world where nothing stays stable for long.

Take control of Ella's ghostly kitchen by combining 3 ingredients into her mysterious cooking pot, each mix can create new recipes, unlock new encounters with Ella, or accidentally trigger bizarre glitched events. 

Features

  • 💀 Addicting Rogue-Like Deckbuilding Gameplay with it's own spooky twist! 
    Fast, addicting roguelike runs built around Cheat Cards, skills, and synergy-driven builds.

  • 🧟 4 Unique Stages - 4 Difficulty Modes.

    • 🥣 The Haunted Kitchen - Normal Mode.

    • 🧹 The Witch’s Castle - Hard Mode.

    • 🧪 The Atomic Kitchen - Very Hard Mode.

    • 💋 Ella’s Backstage - Endless Mode. 

  • 🥩 24 Ingredients with 50 Recipe Combos.

  • 💚 11 Unique Skills Each with their own special animations.

  • 📖 135 Cheat Cards Used to build decks and create powerful synergies.

  • 👻 Fully Voiced Ghost Girl.

  • 🎭 Customize Ella with 5 Unlockable Skins.

  • 🎶 16 Music Tracks.

  • 🛒 5 Gameplay Upgrades and  10 Special Animated Scenes Available in the Shop.

  • Single-player experience.

  • Estimated playtime: ~6 - 20 hours depending on RNG. Runs can last a few minutes. Full play time and completion has not been fully estimated. 

  • Adult Content: Intended for an Adult Only audience.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of sexual acts, stylized nudity, and exaggerated character designs. Certain scenes may be interpreted as pornographic in nature. Sexual content is presented in a fictional and stylized context.
The game does not contain depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual sexual acts, self-harm, or substance abuse.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, or Windows 11 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: No VR support.
  • Additional Notes: A keyboard and mouse. May experience occasional frame dips on older integrated graphics.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: No VR support.
  • Additional Notes: A keyboard and mouse. May experience occasional frame dips on older integrated graphics.

short_description: A chaotic roguelike deckbuilder set inside a haunted television show. Combine ingredients, unlock recipes, and build powerful synergies as runs escalate into glitches, strange sexy encounters, and unpredictable outcomes.
